# function: base64gunzip

Decodes the given Base64 string using the standard alphabet and decompresses the result with gzip. This is the inverse of `base64gzip`.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
base64gunzip(str string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `str` (String) The Base64 encoded, gzip compressed string to decode.
